visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with short pigtails wearing a pink cherry-print sundress stands on a light wooden floor. She looks upwards with wide, expressive eyes and moves her small hands while speaking. The background is a clean, bright indoor home setting with white walls and a power outlet visible. (2) The camera angle shifts as the girl sits on the wooden floor, looking up expectantly. An adult's hand with manicured nails enters the frame holding a smartphone to record her. The lighting is soft and natural, coming from a nearby window. (3) The girl reaches out her tiny hands to receive a small, thin snack piece from an adult. She carefully puts it in her mouth and starts chewing, her facial expressions showing satisfaction. A white air purifier and a wooden chair leg are visible in the background. (4) The girl stands up and walks briskly away from the camera towards a white wall. She then turns back, her pigtails bouncing. Another child's legs are briefly seen in the background as they move past. (5) The scene transitions to the girl standing next to an adult wearing light-colored trousers and a gray shirt. She looks up at them while gesturing towards her mouth. The background shows a modern open-plan kitchen with wooden cabinets and a refrigerator. (6) A woman in a light-colored T-shirt stands in the kitchen, holding a yellow and brown bag of Calbee chips. The girl approaches her, looking up with a pleading, sweet expression, occasionally pointing to the bag. (7) The final frame is a solid pink background featuring a small, cute cartoon illustration of the girl in the center. White text below the illustration reads "POPO'S DAILY LIFE," centered on the screen.
